items.title: Remove requirements corpus reads and prompt concatenation
items.context: Delete the recursive readFileSync requirements traversal and truthDocs.join Truth Source assembly in packages/main/src/handlers/story-review.ts without weakening existing PLAN artifact and scope-check gates.

happy.desc: Run the focused story-review corpus-budget smoke after the handler change -> the generated _reviewPrompt contains no requirements corpus body, no per-document Truth Source concatenation, and the ordinary PLAN review result still returns successfully; WHY: proves the producer-side full-corpus injection is actually removed without disabling story_review.

edge.desc: Create requirementsDir with nested Markdown files plus non-Markdown files and invoke story_review -> none of their unique sentinel contents appear in _reviewPrompt and no recursive corpus read is required for success; WHY: covers the exact former traversal boundary rather than only a single top-level document.

adversarial.desc: Add an unrelated multi-megabyte Markdown sentinel under requirementsDir before invoking story_review -> prompt bytes remain within a small fixed tolerance of the baseline and the sentinel is absent; WHY: prevents reintroduction through an alternate read/join path or size-only truncation workaround.

items.title: Preserve structured PLAN review prompt content
items.context: Keep story metadata, understanding, decision and preMortem, grill context, experience hints, ProofStory diagnostics, checklist, and verificationIntent output stable while replacing truthDocsCount with an honest non-corpus contract.

happy.desc: Generate _reviewPrompt for a fully populated PLAN story -> story metadata, understanding, decision with preMortem, grill context, experience hints, ProofStory diagnostics, checklist entries, and verificationIntent remain present with their representative values; WHY: protects every structured review input explicitly promised by the story.

edge.desc: Generate _reviewPrompt when optional structured artifacts or arrays are empty/missing in combinations already accepted by story_review -> output remains well-formed and preserves existing gate/blocker behavior instead of throwing because corpus text was removed; WHY: checks sparse PLAN-state compatibility.

adversarial.desc: Supply requirement-like sentinel prose only inside an unrelated requirements document while supplying distinct sentinel values in signed/structured PLAN artifacts -> only structured artifact sentinels appear in _reviewPrompt and review decisions still derive from those artifacts; WHY: proves gate semantics were not silently replaced by corpus prose or weakened during cleanup.

items.title: Add corpus-size regression coverage
items.context: Prove a large unrelated requirements Markdown file is absent from _reviewPrompt and cannot make prompt bytes scale with the requirements corpus; retain structured-output compatibility where intentional.

items.title: Measure task token cost and identify the dominant source
items.context: Record the pre-fix and post-fix _reviewPrompt byte/token estimates plus available host usage for this repair, and report which input surface dominates cost.
